mp.pillar: Sustained Dominance: higher positions, longer presence and higher peak positions on Most Popular.
observations: Steal An Egg (78 days) still leads Most Popular ahead of Brookhaven, 99 Nights in the Forest, Murder Mystery 2, the 266-day +1 Speed Keyboard Escape and RIVALS; the top six are unchanged in membership.
Today's snapshot is again flagged partial (public lists only), so no presence day was added and day-based confidences stayed flat on four recorded days.

Games past a year keep the best median pillar percentile (58), 15-42 day games sit at 52, and the 85-365 day bands sit at 34, which keeps the mid-life trough idea (H-mp-009, 35%) speculative but consistent with today.
The weakest holders are Swing For Eggs, the 1,079-day DON'T GET ELIMINATED, +1 Paint Keyboard Adventure and Board Of Hell.
patterns: Higher pass prices (H-mp-001, 63%) and dev products above 79 Robux (H-mp-011, 64%) tend to go with higher and longer presence; studio maturity and age remain likely confounders.
Novelty now correlates with position (rho = +0.30), the first clear sign for originality on this chart; a new tested idea tracks it alongside H-mp-005 (47%), which uses days on chart.
Plain gameplay-screenshot thumbnails go with fewer days on the chart (r = -0.22, 39 games), echoing the same signal on Top Trending; a new tested idea tracks it.

Bigger servers (H-mp-007, now 54%) and solo loops sitting lower (H-mp-003, 55%) both weakened with today's added profiles; generic 2x passes tend to sit lower (H-mp-012, 64%), likely marking the simulator template.
Combat PvP (68) and roleplay (66) loops keep the best median percentiles; obby (27), job sims (25) and story adventures (24) sit lowest.

outliers.name: Steal An Egg
outliers.note: A 78-day template game at #1 above multi-year evergreens, against the template-is-short-lived idea; the steal/egg wave is at its peak.

outliers.name: DON'T GET ELIMINATED
outliers.note: A three-year-old party game near the bottom, a counterexample to evergreen strength, probably held up by a recurring short-session party wave.

te.pillar: Monetization Efficiency: earning a high position with modest CCU (Monetization Score ranks position × CCU, lower is better).
observations: Donation and social-spending games still top efficiency (Donation Central, Summer Donations, Simple DONATIONS), joined by evil plate game, Korea Army and Strikeborn.
The 15-42 day band has the weakest median efficiency (18) against 57 for games past a year, matching H-te-001 (69%).
The weakest monetizers are young breakouts updated today: Peel THE Potato, Firefighting Sim, 7 Days Cat-Sitting and Makeup Mania!.
The list is again the public chart only (479 games); single-snapshot noise for small games (H-te-019, 45%) still applies.
patterns: Most tested ideas sit at the 69% ceiling set by five recorded days: dev products above 79 Robux, bracket tags, codes, 25+ player servers, RPG genre, complexity and longer descriptions tend to go with better efficiency, and more days are needed before any reads as consistent.

Combat PvP (41 profiled games, median 60), tower defense (72) and story adventure (76) loops rank high, while '+1' incrementals (21), wave-survival co-op (20) and sandbox physics (15) rank low, which may point to depth-driven spending.
Pet/egg (r = -0.26), '+1', anime and steal titles tend to sit low on efficiency, consistent with H-x-002.
Caps-heavy titles show a positive link (r = +0.26) opposite to their Most Popular effect; it may simply mark older update-tagged games, and a new tested idea tracks it without an action.

outliers.name: Strikeborn [EARLY ACCESS]
outliers.note: No game passes at all yet among the six most efficient games, against the pass-pricing ideas; early-access product sales may concentrate spending.

outliers.name: Firefighting Sim
outliers.note: Sells products above typical prices yet is among the weakest, a counterexample to H-te-005, likely because it is 19 days old and its player count outruns revenue.

tt.pillar: Early Momentum: rapid upward movement on Top Trending, among games 0–4 months old only.
tt.metric: daily position gain on Top Trending
observations: COCARDO: LA HELADERIA, Hide In Pixels and Lift Rock For Eggs lead momentum, followed by Shoot For Eggs, Climb For Animals Eggs and the 87-day Anime Zero.
The 0-14 day band keeps a median momentum percentile of 96 versus 43 for 15-42 day games, though the young band has only three scored games.
Steal templates (Steal A Car, Steal an Clown Egg) and the party format I Can Read Your Mind are the weakest climbers.
Hatch-collect-pets loops keep the best median momentum among profiled loops (93), party minigames the worst (16).
patterns: Plain gameplay thumbnails tend to go with weaker momentum (H-tt-012, 56%; within-age -0.62), and reward-flex thumbnails tend to go with stronger momentum (H-tt-006, 56%).
PvP loops tend to climb more slowly (H-tt-011, 57%; within-age -0.51), and pet/egg games tend to hold higher positions (H-tt-013, 59%).

A VIP pass goes with faster climbs (r = +0.34) while generic 2x passes go with lower positions (within-age -0.55); two new tested ideas track these, and simulator-template genre mix is the obvious confounder for the second.
Short descriptions (H-tt-003, now 53%) and the six-week cutoff (H-tt-001, 47%) both weakened; age alone explains little of momentum within this chart (within-age effect -0.10).

outliers.name: Anime Zero [Void Arbiter]
outliers.note: At 87 days it climbs like a two-week game, again the main counterexample to H-tt-001, likely driven by its fresh 'Void Arbiter' content update.

outliers.name: [🎨] Hide In Pixels
outliers.note: A party format with a 59% like ratio among the top climbers, against H-tt-004 and the weakness of party loops.

uc.pillar: Breakout Popularity: higher positions within Up-and-Coming.
observations: Huss Valley (41 days) now leads, ahead of Get Your Driver's License! (24% likes), Makeup Mania!, Sell Fries! [Anomaly], COCARDO and Break and Steal an Egg.
Today's 60 new profiles covered many chart entries, among them a backrooms maze tycoon, a packing tycoon, an AI-judged pancake painter, a bricklaying sandbox and a +1 rock-lifting incremental.
Egg titles make up 17% of the chart (r = +0.27) and '+1' titles 9% (r = -0.48), the strongest keyword split on this chart.
The weakest holders are Locust Murder Mystery, Create Pottery!, Open Sea For Animals! and 2 Player Pizza Tycoon.
patterns: Selling currency packs goes with higher positions (r = +0.40, within-age +0.37) and more updates per week goes with higher positions (r = +0.33); both are new tested ideas next to H-uc-012 (60%), which tends to favor recently updated games.
Cash-tycoon loops tend to rank lower (r = -0.29 within age), matching the low idle-tycoon median (30); a new tested idea tracks it.
Solo loops tend to rank lower (H-uc-007, now 58%) and character-art thumbnails tend to rank higher (H-uc-011, 59%); '+1' incrementals tend to rank low (H-uc-003, 60%).
Horror-escape (87) and hatch-pets (81) loops hold the best medians, while like ratio still shows no reliable link (H-uc-006, 47%).

outliers.name: Get Your Driver's License!
outliers.note: Second place with a 24% like ratio, likely curiosity and meme traffic outrunning satisfaction; a new speculative idea tracks such curiosity hooks.

outliers.name: Locust Murder Mystery
outliers.note: A horror/1-vs-all game at the bottom while horror-escape loops otherwise rank high, probably because it is a murder-mystery clone rather than an escape.

summary: Every chart was again flagged partial, so day-based tests did not advance; movement came from 60 new gameplay profiles (342 profiled in total).

The popularity-versus-revenue split held: egg and steal templates lift Up-and-Coming and Top Trending entries but sit low on Top Earning efficiency, while RPG, combat PvP, tower defense and donation hubs earn most per player.
Plain gameplay-screenshot thumbnails now point the same way on Most Popular and Top Trending, the first thumbnail signal seen on two charts.
Generic 2x passes go with lower positions on both Most Popular and Top Trending, which may reflect the simulator-template genre rather than the pass itself.
Survival genre splits the charts: lower efficiency on Top Earning (H-te-021, 69%) but higher Up-and-Coming positions (r = +0.31), consistent with horror-escape breakouts that monetize late.
progressions: Up-and-Coming to Top Trending remains the most common path (17 games, median 2 days), then Top Earning to Top Trending (11, 3 days) and Up-and-Coming to Top Earning (10, 1 day).
Top Trending to Most Popular stays the main entry into Most Popular (10 games, 2 days), ahead of Up-and-Coming to Most Popular (5, 1 day).
No new progressions were counted today because the snapshot's lists are flagged partial.
